database_description_header:
description: |-
  This file contains data for gas phase species from the NASA thermodynamic
  database, which is available for download from
  https://shepherd.caltech.edu/EDL/PublicResources/sdt/thermo.html.
  The original source is:

  B.J. McBride, S. Gordon, and M.A. Reno, "Coefficients for Calculating
  Thermodynamic and Transport Properties of Individual Species", NASA
  Report TM-4513, October 1993. https://ntrs.nasa.gov/citations/19940013151

  The 'note' field for each species indicates the source and date for the data used
  to generate the polynomial fits, as given by McBride et al. The abbreviations and
  corresponding references are given in the report.

generator: ck2yaml
input-files: [nasa_gas.dat]
cantera-version: 2.6.0
date: Wed, 20 Apr 2022 22:21:10 -0400

units: {length: cm, time: s, quantity: mol, activation-energy: cal/mol}
interpretation: Fixed-composition UV compares caloric thermodynamics at the same conserved density, composition and energy. Equilibrium UV changes composition and is only a limiting sensitivity; it does not establish the local relaxation rate, shock cause, or actual flow temperature.
